talk.speaker: Ansa Rook
talk.text: I watched the ship's lanterns go under, from the wall behind my house. I sat there until it was light. I am sorry for whoever you lost out there. It does not matter what they were.

thanks.speaker: Ansa Rook
thanks.text: Eat something. Bram will not charge you for the stew. He never charges anyone for the stew; it is how he keeps his conscience clean.
